po.name: Mentor Agile Product Owner Product Manager
po.description: A 12-week program combining live online instruction, recorded lessons, practical projects, and career preparation, designed for adults entering or developing skills in Agile product roles.
objectives: Explain Agile values, Scrum accountabilities and events, and the use of Kanban to manage work.
Translate customer and stakeholder needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
Prioritize and refine a product backlog and define a minimum viable product (MVP).
Develop a product roadmap and explain release-planning choices.
Communicate product decisions and trade-offs to stakeholders and delivery teams.
Prepare career materials and explain product work in interviews.
po.sequence: Phase 1 Beginner (weeks 1–3) · Phase 2 Intermediate (weeks 4–6) · Phase 3 Advanced (weeks 7–8) · Phase 4 Career Launchpad (weeks 9–12).
po.admission: At least 18 years old; basic computer literacy; English proficiency sufficient for instruction; reliable computer and internet; commitment to the full 12 weeks. High school diploma or equivalent: [NEEDS: "recommended" (catalog) or "required" (ETPL listing)].
fees: Testing / credentialing fees (e.g., CSPO course booking)
po.disclosure: PY2025 (Jul 1, 2025–Jun 30, 2026) and PY2024, as posted on the Program Disclosures page: 80 students, 68 exits, 85% reported rates for PY2025; 3 students for PY2024.

pharm.name: AI-Enhanced Pharmacy Technician & EKG Technician
pharm.description: A fully remote program preparing students for entry-level work as pharmacy technicians and EKG technicians. It combines live instruction led by a PharmD with virtual simulations and VR skill labs covering pharmacy law, pharmacology, medication safety, prescription processing, calculations, and pharmacy workflow, plus an EKG track covering lead placement, cardiac anatomy, and rhythm interpretation. Students prepare for the PTCB Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT) exam and an EKG technician certification exam. Credentials are issued by the certifying bodies, not by Mentor Agile.
